buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Chamera-II Power Station Karian Distt.Chamba Himachal Pradesh PIN-176318 . 3. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 4. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Qualifying/Eligibility criteria: 1. a) The bidder should be Manufacturer of similar size of battery capacity and associated battery charger s for quoted brands of the item of required configuration /specifications as specified in the NIT. Or b) The bidder should be Manufacturer of similar size of battery capacity and have a tie up agreement / MO U / collaboration agreement with manufacturer of battery chargers for quoted brands of the item of require d configuration /specifications as specified in the NIT. Or

c) The bidder should be Manufacturer of similar size of battery chargers and have a tie up agreement / MO U / collaboration agreement with manufacturer / authorized channel partner/dealer/distributor/ of similar si ze of battery capacity for quoted brands of the item of required configuration /specifications as specified in the NIT. Or d) The bidder should be authorized channel partner/dealer/distributor/ System Integrator of similar size of battery capacity and associated battery chargers for quoted brands of the item of required configuration /s pecifications as specified in the NIT to quote on behalf of their manufacturer, in case manufacturer does n ot quote directly. In such a case, the authorized dealer shall have to submit relevant ‘Authorized Dealership” certificate from the manufacturer & the bidder shall be eligible for submitting the past experience of OEM to meet eligibilit y /qualifying criteria in that case. Similar size equipment/system is defined as: (i) Minimum 110V, 100 A (DC output) Battery Chargers. (ii) Minimum 110V, 600 AH Lead Acid Battery Banks or Minimum 600 AH Nickel Cadmium Fibre Plate/Pocke t Plate Battery Bank” Note:- a) In case a dealer is participating in a tender on behalf of one manufacturer, he is not allowed to participa te / quote on behalf of another manufacturer in this tender or in a parallel for the same item. All such bids with same make/ manufacturer will be rejected. illustration: In case a dealer has participated in the tender and submitted two bids for two different makes/ manufacturer, both the bids of the bidder will be rejected. Therefore, only one bid shall be submitted. Further, if manufacturer as defined in 1a), b) &c) of particular make has participated in the tender, bid of a uthorized dealer for that make shall not be considered for evaluation. b) The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in support of manufacturing of quoted brand/ make alon g with tie up agreement / MOU / collaboration agreement as the case may be. 2. The bidder/OEM/ tie up / MOU / collaboration firm solely or jointly should have successfully supplied, Ins talled, tested and commissioned minimum two similar equipment/system of similar size as defined above during last Seven (7) years last day of the month previous to the one in which NIT is published. The bidder/ OEM should submit authenticated copies of supply orders issued by various clients for the type/model/mak e of the offered equipment/system. 3. The equipment/ system so manufactured should have been in successful operation at least one Year fro m the date of commissioning. In support of same, the bidder/OEM should submit authenticated copies of P erformance Certificate issued by various clients for the type/model/make of the supplied equipment/syste m 4. The bidder should submit a valid ISO certification of manufacturer for manufacturing the specified equip ment / system with the bid.

B. Financial Criteria: (a) Average Annual Financial turnover during the last 3 years, ending 31st March of the previous finan cial year, should be at least 50% of the estimated cost. In support of the same, the bidder should submit Annual Report (Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss a ccount with UDIN) of the relevant period, duly authenticated by a Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant i n India. (b) The working capital (current assets minus current liabilities) shall be equal to at least 3 times the m onthly cash flow requirement i.e. Estimated cost of Work*3/Delivery period in months (INR). (C) Net Worth: The net worth of the Bidder firm (manufacturer or principal of authorized representative) (i) should not be negative on 31st March 2026 and also (ii) if it is less than paid up equity share capital then it should not have been eroded by more th an 30% (thirty percent) in the last three years, ending on the 31st March 2026. (d) The bidders against whom proceedings for insolvency under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 (as amended time to time) have been started shall not be eligible for bidding. * Bidder has to submit requisite declaration as per format attached in ATC C. Following should be read with Payment Terms: i) The copies of the challan/Invoice must clearly mention the GST No. 02AAACN0149C1ZB of Chamera- II Power Station in the name of “NHPC Limited, Chamera-II Power Station. ii) Bidders whose turnover is Rs 5 Crore or more will have to comply with the E-invoice provision as per latest notifications of Ministry of Finance (Govt. of India). iii) The supplier must have to submit E-way Bill, Guarantee/ Warrantee, Test Report (if any), Insurance, LR Receipt etc. (Whichever is applicable as per Supply order) and Declaration for Income Tax Return Filing Status as per the provided format. The ITR Acknowledgments or screen shot from the income t ax website indicating the filing of return for FY 2024-25(AY 2025-26) shall be submitted after filing th e same within the time allowed under Section 139 (1) of Income Tax Act, 1961. iv) The supplier is required to provide the GeM generated Invoice along with the original Tax Invoice. T he details in both the invoices must be identical to ensure successful processing of payment. D. EMD to be submitted at following address : HOD (P & C Division), Chamera – II Power Station, NHPC Ltd., Karian, Dist. Chamba Himachal Pradesh – 176310 E-mail ID: gem-chamera2@nhpc.nic.in In case of EMD submission in the form of Demand Draft: Payable to: NHPC Ltd., Payable at SBI Chamba, Himachal Pradesh, IFSC Code : SBIN0000626 In case of EMD submission in the form of Bank Guarantee: · It should be strictly in NHPC Format attached at ATC · Bank Guarantee for Earnest Money Deposit should be executed on non-judicial Stamp papers of requisite value

· Stamp paper shall be purchased in the name of Bank issuing the Bank Guarantee (First Party: issuing Ban k, Second Party: NHPC Ltd.) · Bank Guarantee should be issued on 100% margin or issued by Bank utilizing the credit limit of the bidder . · Bank Guarantee issuing Bank should provide confirmation of the Bank Guarantee through SFMS (Structur ed Financial Messaging System) to the NHPC’s Beneficiary Bank · Name of the beneficiary : NHPC Limited Account No.: 00000011149810095 IFSC Code: SBIN0000626 Address of the Bank: SBI Chamba Branch, Main Market Chamba, PO-Chamba, Distt. Chamba (HP) Pincode-176310 Bidder is required to submit the SFMS receipt issued by the bank along with its bid for BG Confirmation. E. In case of successful bidder PBG (In NHPC Format) to be submitted at following address : HOD (Stores Division), Chamera – II Power Station, NHPC Ltd., Karian, Dist.
